I am an old woman, and I have farmed this land for many years. This small barley plot near the house I manage carefully — I will put some DAP fertilizer because the soil is tired, but urea is expensive and I use only a little. I save manure from my cattle and spread it before plowing, and I use the barley seed I kept from last harvest because improved seed costs too much and the local one grows well in our highland. I do not have irrigation here, we wait for the belg and meher rains, and my children help me weed so I do not need to hire many people.
